description: Defines the TsRollingArgumentEntry class, which manages time series rolling data, including adding, updating, and converting data entries, with support for different data types and cleanup of expired records.

classes.name: TsRollingArgumentEntry
classes.description: Manages a time series rolling window with methods for updating, converting, and cleaning up data entries, supporting multiple data types and integrating with external scripting and data frameworks.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of argument entry, specifically TS_ROLLING.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the time series record map is empty.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the internal time series record map.

methods.name: getLatestTs
methods.description: Retrieves the latest timestamp from the records or a default value.

methods.name: toTbelCfArg
methods.description: Converts the record data into a TbelCfTsRollingArg object for scripting.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates the current entry with data from another ArgumentEntry, supporting both TsRollingArgumentEntry and SingleValueArgumentEntry types.

methods.name: updateTsRollingEntry
methods.description: Merges another TsRollingArgumentEntry into this one.

methods.name: updateSingleValueEntry
methods.description: Updates the record with a single value entry.

methods.name: addTsRecord
methods.description: Adds a timestamped record, with overload for raw double values.

methods.name: cleanupExpiredRecords
methods.description: Removes records outside the time window or exceeding the limit.

methods.name: getValueForTsRecord
methods.description: Converts KvEntry data to a Double, supporting multiple data types, with error handling.
